scope: Local repair, eye interiors and penless paw only; approved artwork is preserved elsewhere
repairPrompt: Prepare a local compositing repair plate from THIS approved Buddy image. Keep exact same canvas/registration, seated position and all unchanged artwork. No redesign, no colour/texture/lighting changes. Make ONLY these technical edits: (1) Remove the green/gold pen COMPLETELY, both cap above the paw and nib on the card. (2) Remove ONLY the right writing paw (viewer LEFT foreground rounded paw holding the pen), reconstructing the lavender chest/short upper arm and blank cream card that were hidden behind it. Keep the opposite supporting paw, feet, card position, body and head untouched. This is an under-layer; the app restores the ORIGINAL approved paw image and a separately rendered pen on top. No extra paw/pen fragments. (3) Within EACH existing glossy black eye, move its single MAIN round white highlight from the upper part to the lower-middle (about50%horizontal,68%vertical). Same circle size; clear BLACK margin all around. Remove old upper main circle so not double. Keep eye outlines, roundness, secondary subtle gloss and 3D shading exact. Do not add sclera or redraw facial features. The app uses only small eye-interior and repair-region patches from this plate and preserves original approved artwork everywhere else. Preserve blush/smile/ears/head and lavender plush fur. Card stays blank. Fullbody transparent alpha image, same framing as input, no background/shadow, no marks or text.
penlessPrompt: Technical localized PEN REMOVAL ONLY from this approved Buddy still. Preserve exact canvas dimensions, registration, fur texture/colour/lighting, seated body, all paws and arm positions, entire head/face/eyes/highlights/ears/blush/smile, feet and small cream card. REMOVE ONLY the green/gold pen, all cap/barrel/nib pieces, reconstructing the tiny underlying plush or blank cream paper where it covered them. Especially keep the writing paw (viewer LEFT) round and exactly in the existing grip pose; do not remove or move that paw. No new fingers, no other changes, no smoothing/darkening/brightening. Card remains blank. Same full-body transparent alpha image with exact placement. App will use only the writing-paw region from this penless plate and preserve the approved source elsewhere. No background/shadow/text/ink.
